<details>

It contains three subpackages for TTF, variable TTF, and WOFF2 formats, each installing font files into standard system directories under `$pkgdir`. The source is fetched via `git+https://github.com/googlefonts/lexend.git`, which is the legitimate upstream repository. The use of `sha256sums=('SKIP')` is expected and standard for VCS-based packages in the AUR, especially `-git` packages, as the content is inherently mutable. The build process consists solely of copying pre-generated font files from the cloned repository to appropriate locations, with no compilation or execution of code.

No network operations, file modifications, or system interactions occur beyond standard packaging practices. The script does not use dangerous commands like `eval`, `curl`, or `wget` to download or execute unverified content. All installed files are publicly available font assets licensed under OFL-1.1-RFN, and the package includes proper license installation. The operations are limited to file installation and metadata setup, consistent with AUR packaging norms.

There is no obfuscated code, unexpected behavior, or signs of supply-chain compromise. The package only handles its own declared upstream source and performs no runtime modifications. All actions align with the stated purpose of distributing open-source fonts.
</details>
